text: This is my webpage where I showcase myself and the work I have done. Enjoy!

myselfSection.heading: Myself
text: I am currently working as a full-stack developer for the SoulJourney Group in Regensburg, Germany. In my career, I have worked on projects for The Lego Group, Kia, Vodafone, Diebold Nixdorf, and Achtsamkeitsakademie.
I also study the Software Development BSc program at the International University of Applied Sciences. I love learning new things and solving real-world problems.

work.heading: MY WORK
work.labText: I showcase my work in my free time. Either I’m learning new things, have new ideas, or want to showcase some of my skills. If you find anything interesting or any bugs, please don't hesitate to contact me. Thank you.

introduction.heading: Full-stack Developer
text: My journey in IT started as 1st level support at Generali, through software engineering at M&S in Diebold Nixdorf, and finally led to SoulJourney Group, where I'm working as a full-stack developer.

introduction.heading: My Aim
text: … is to deliver reliable, maintainable software that meets business needs and scales effectively. I focus on clean architecture, strong testing practices, and continuous improvement while staying open to new technologies and collaboration opportunities.
My primary experience spans backend and frontend development with TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Next.js/Astro, Express, and both NoSQL and SQL databases.
Recently, I have expanded my expertise in AWS, serverless functions, event-driven architectures, monorepo workflows, and AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery and improve productivity.

I also use collaboration and productivity tools such as Git, Figma, Jira/Asana, and maintain organization with Bullet Journal. For automation, I rely on Zapier and Activepieces. I speak Czech, English, German, and Slovak.

aboutMe.projects: Sadly, I don’t currently have any real-world application in regular use; I’m just learning and creating “lab” projects to showcase my work.

myHobbies.basketball: One of my favorite hobbies is basketball because it balances my life with the IT world. Currently, I play for ASV Cham in Bavaria, Germany. I also like to watch NBA games from time to time when they are on.
myHobbies.movies: When I want to completely switch off and just relax, I prefer watching movies rather than TV shows. One of my favorite movies is 500 Days of Summer, and I watch anything with Christopher Nolan’s signature style.
myHobbies.race sims: Another thing that gives me a happy hour of freedom is racing sims. I love to play F1, open-world Forza, or some serious iRacing with its awesome community.
myHobbies.music: I don't have many addictions, but music is one of them. From rap and hip-hop through rock and indie to electronic music like Stimming. I listen to almost every genre, mainly when working because it helps me focus.
